_description: NeuroSim (DNN_NeuroSim_V1.4) inference-accuracy settings for the Laleni et al. 2024 1F1C macro. Keys under 'args' are passed 1:1 as --key value to Inference_pytorch/inference.py. Run with: python3 targets/1fefet1c/run_neurosim.py default

_provenance.dataset, model: Laleni Sec. V: pretrained VGG-8 on CIFAR-10 using NeuroSim [35]; NeuroSim's shipped log/VGG8.pth
_provenance.mode: WAGE: the mode VGG8.pth was trained in
_provenance.wl_weight, wl_activate: NeuroSim defaults (8/8); Laleni does not state weight/activation precision
_provenance.inference: 1 = apply the hardware non-idealities below (0 = ideal quantized network)
_provenance.parallelRead: all 128 rows read at once (charge-domain MAC over the full column); NeuroSim requires parallelRead == subArray when cellBit > 1
_provenance.onoffratio: NeuroSim default; Laleni does not state it. Physically the HVT (Vth = 1.2 V) cell stores ~0 charge (Laleni Fig. 5), i.e. a much larger ratio
_provenance.vari: From Laleni Fig. 7(b) (60 FeFETs x 4 states), read off the fitted Gaussians: Vth = 0.35/0.63/0.95/1.24 V, sigma = 17/42/50/36 mV. A cell stores VDD - Vth, so sigma(Vth) is the stored-voltage error; with the linear scheme of Fig. 10(b) (0.3 V per weight level) that is 0.057/0.14/0.17 weight-LSB for w = 3/2/1 (w = 0, Vth > 1 V, stores ~0). NeuroSim applies one multiplicative sigma per cell, w*(1+N(0,vari)); matching the mean error power over w = 1..3: vari = sqrt(mean(0.057^2, 0.14^2, 0.17^2) / mean(1, 4, 9)) = 0.06. Run with vari = 0 gave 91.80 %
